_comment: Cut 0 of 4 -- 14 px long. Built along +Z from the north edge; the blockstate rotates this one set for the other three facings. Face UVs are deliberately left to the auto-generation, which samples each length from the same tileable texture.
__display_comment: The item is this model, and minecraft:block/block draws every block at 0.625 in a slot. A 4 px slab lying at the bottom of its block then comes out smaller than one cut piece of it, so the bar gets its own GUI transform: nearly full scale, lifted into the middle of the slot. Only the item is affected -- display never applies to the placed block.
